value.rationale: Largest fiber size is a sharp worst-case inverse ambiguity of the complete exact two-gram read channel, and (2/pi)2^n/n provides the leading constant. Complete classification of all extremal read profiles exposes transition-balance rigidity and four modular boundary effects. This solves a natural, exact, all-length optimization problem and goes beyond singleton counts and simple parameter renaming.
